approvals_kind_fields.name: approvals_kind_fields
approvals_kind_fields.value: ("approvals"."kind" = 'message' and "approvals"."message" is not null and "approvals"."signature" is not null) or ("approvals"."kind" = 'execution' and "approvals"."execution_signature" is not null)

chain_activity_public_amount.name: chain_activity_public_amount
chain_activity_public_amount.value: ("chain_activity"."instruction_type" in ('deposit', 'withdraw')) = ("chain_activity"."public_amount_base_units" is not null) and ("chain_activity"."public_amount_base_units" is null or "chain_activity"."public_amount_base_units" >= 0)

grants_period_bounds.name: grants_period_bounds
grants_period_bounds.value: "grants"."scope" <> 'period' or ("grants"."period_from" is not null and "grants"."period_to" is not null and "grants"."period_from" <= "grants"."period_to")

payments_kind_run.name: payments_kind_run
payments_kind_run.value: ("payments"."kind" = 'payroll_line' and "payments"."run_id" is not null and "payments"."line_no" is not null and "payments"."line_no" >= 1) or ("payments"."kind" = 'single' and "payments"."run_id" is null and "payments"."line_no" is null)

waitlist_email_shape.name: waitlist_email_shape
waitlist_email_shape.value: char_length("waitlist"."email") between 3 and 254 and "waitlist"."email" = lower("waitlist"."email") and position('@' in "waitlist"."email") > 1
